title: Interaction range changes the magnetic ground state

source.extraction: Numbers are approximate values explicitly stated in the adjacent prose; selected discrete checkpoints only. No curve digitisation, interpolation, simulation, or visual point estimates.

method: DFT exchange tensors mapped by LKAG to classical unit-vector spin Hamiltonians; finite-temperature classical Monte Carlo; Tc from heat-capacity peaks.

materials.interpretation_display: The state converges before its ordering temperature. Weaker distant couplings still change the thermal prediction.
materials.caution: 7 is the prose-reported ground-state convergence criterion, not first onset of spiral order. The 7-shell temperature is intentionally not transcribed.

materials.interpretation_display: The fifth shell changes the selected order. More shells leave the state and temperature essentially unchanged.
materials.caution: 61 K is the raw classical-model result, not the experimentally measured 120 K and not a quantum-corrected temperature.
